mapper.sql: CASE WHEN M.USER_CD IS NULL THEN 'PENDING_REAGREE' WHEN M.CONSENT_STATE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(M.CONSENT_STATE) <> '' THEN M.CONSENT_STATE WHEN IFNULL(M.AGR_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'AGREED' ELSE 'WITHDRAWN' END
mapper.select: /* Location01Mapper.selectConsentHistList */ SELECT H.HIST_ID AS histId , H.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion , H.BEFORE_STATE AS beforeState , H.AFTER_STATE AS afterState , H.BEFORE_AGR_YN AS beforeAgrYn , H.AFTER_AGR_YN AS afterAgrYn , H.AGR_SOURCE AS agrSource , H.ACTOR_USER_CD AS actorUserCd /* 수행자 표시용 — 정규/일용직 두 계통을 각각 조인해 먼저 잡히는 쪽을 쓴다. ★계정이 삭제됐거나 SYSTEM(약관 버전업) 이면 둘 다 NULL 이고, 화면이 코드로 폴백한다. */ , COALESCE(AU.USER_ID, AD.USER_ID) AS actorUserId , COALESCE(AU.USER_NM, AD.USER_NM) AS actorUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(H.ACTION_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS actionDtime FROM TB_TERMS_USER_AGR_HIST H LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER AU ON (AU.CMPNY_CD = H.ACTOR_CMPNY_CD AND AU.USER_CD = H.ACTOR_USER_CD) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER AD ON (AD.CMPNY_CD = H.ACTOR_CMPNY_CD AND AD.USER_CD = H.ACTOR_USER_CD) WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND H.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND H.TERMS_ID = '005' ORDER BY H.ACTION_DTIME DESC, H.HIST_ID DESC LIMIT 200

/* Location01Mapper.selectPurgeHistList */ SELECT P.PURGE_ID AS purgeId , P.PURGE_REASON_CD AS purgeReasonCd , P.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion , P.ATTD_GPS_ROWS AS attdGpsRows , P.TBM_ATTENDANCE_ROWS AS tbmAttendanceRows , P.TBM_SESSION_ROWS AS tbmSessionRows , P.OLDEST_COLLECTED AS oldestCollected , P.LATEST_COLLECTED AS latestCollected , P.ACTOR_USER_CD AS actorUserCd /* 수행자 표시용 — 배치(SYSTEM) 실행분은 계정이 없어 NULL 이고, 화면이 코드로 폴백한다. */ , COALESCE(AU.USER_ID, AD.USER_ID) AS actorUserId , COALESCE(AU.USER_NM, AD.USER_NM) AS actorUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(P.ACTION_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS actionDtime FROM TB_LOCATION_PURGE_HIST P LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER AU ON (AU.CMPNY_CD = P.ACTOR_CMPNY_CD AND AU.USER_CD = P.ACTOR_USER_CD) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER AD ON (AD.CMPNY_CD = P.ACTOR_CMPNY_CD AND AD.USER_CD = P.ACTOR_USER_CD) WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USER_CD = #{userCd} ORDER BY P.ACTION_DTIME DESC, P.PURGE_ID DESC LIMIT 200
